evals.py: inserted the `held_out` column into `COLUMNS`, right after `green`.
evals.py: added `_held_out_green`, reading a record's `held_out.json` and returning True only when its `exit` is 0.
evals.py: extended `_passed` with a `held_out` flag so a `green` case also needs the held-out check green; `red` and `refused` unchanged.
evals.py: gave `_row` the `held_out` flag and an empty cell when the case holds no `held_out/`, else the count of runs whose held-out check ended green.

evals.py: in `_run_case`, ran `_held_out` only when the run left a record and its check ended green, before the worktree is removed, letting a raising check propagate as a failed run.
evals.py: computed held-out presence from each case's directory in `_pass_rate` and in `main`'s `_row` call so the column and the pass count agree with the case.
